title: Hearty Crispy Ethiopian Squid Stew
description: Salty and crispy Ethiopian squid stew with a fragrant berbere base, air‑fried squid, and a smoky, no‑onion no‑garlic flavor.
instructions: Clean and slit the squid into 1‑inch pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
Whisk together berbere, ginger, tamarind paste, soy sauce, lemon juice, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Add the squid to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Place the coated squid on an air‑fryer tray lined with parchment and air‑fry at 200°C for 8 minutes until golden and crispy.
Remove the squid from the air‑fryer and set aside.
In a saucepan, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and add 1 tsp berbere and 1 tsp paprika, stirring for 30 seconds.
Stir in 1 cup water and bring to a gentle boil, then whisk in chickpea flour to thicken the broth.
Add the cooked spinach and simmer for 5 minutes until wilted and flavors meld.
Return the crispy squid to the pot, stir to combine, and cook for an additional 2 minutes to heat through.
